record.content: NPS describes the 2026 regional and internal transportation network: year-round Highway 140 YARTS; seasonal Highway 120 east, Highway 120 west, and Highway 41 YARTS; Valley shuttles; the Mariposa Grove and Badger Pass shuttles; the Glacier Point Tour; the Yosemite Valley-to-Tuolumne Meadows hikers bus; and the Tuolumne Meadows shuttle. It states that Hetch Hetchy has no public transportation and that seasonal service depends on dates and conditions.
